annotations.title: Compare FDA adverse-event reports for up to 10 drugs

description: Compare FDA adverse-event reports for up to 10 drugs — FAERS adverse-event report profile for up to 10 drugs (comma separated) in one call: total and serious reports, serious share, top reactions per drug, reactions shared across drugs, reactions distinctive to each drug, most-reported and highest/lowest serious share. Counts reflect voluntary reports, not incidence or causation. Source: openFDA (public domain). Not medical advice. JSON. Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
